- **CodeRabbit summary** (https://github.com/j5ik2o/event-store-adapter-java/pull/871#issuecomment-7206241946):

  - For the failed "Out of Scope Changes" pre-merge check, the PR description now has a section ("Changes beyond the list in #870, and why they are here"). It says which #870 item, or which request, each of the four listed changes serves.
